name: agentguard
description: Stops a runaway burst of sub-agents until you allow it and shows where your Claude Code or Codex tokens went. Runs on your machine.

license_key.title: AgentGuard license key
license_key.description: Only for a paid plan (Solo or Team). Leave empty for Free, which needs no key. Stored in your system credential store and sent only to agentguard.run to check the license.
